section.title: What is DITA?
section.p: DITA (Darwin Information Typing Architecture) is an XML-based architecture for authoring, producing, and delivering topic-oriented, information-typed content.
section.note: You can edit this content directly in the left pane and see changes in real-time!

ul.li: Bold text using the b element
Italic text using the i element
Underlined text using the u element
Teletype text using tt for monospace

dl.dd: Enforces consistent structure and formatting across all content.
Content can be reused across multiple publications and formats.
Streamlines the content creation and maintenance process.
